summary: Federal law has every birth in the country collected and published as one statistic.
realLife: Federal law requires national collection of births and other vital statistics, a joint effort of the national center and the states, built on the certificates.
sources: CDC National Center for Health Statistics, NVSS Birth Data: https://www.cdc.gov/nchs/nvss/births.htm
inGame: needs: a national births count read from the world's born records, for a line about being one of them.
